chain.label: Icing certification envelope excluded freezing drizzle/SLD
chain.trigger: FAR 25 Appendix C "does not consider the existence of supercooled droplets or drops having a diameter over 40µm ... nor the case of freezing drizzle or freezing rain"

chain.label: Unprotected wing area aft of de-icing boots on unpowered-aileron ATR 72
chain.trigger: "the ice-induced aileron hinge moment reversal phenomenon and its associated flow separation behind the boots at low Angle of Attack was discovered for the very first time"

caused_by.evidence: "Considering that these procedures addressed a condition outside the certification requirements, the DGAC did not request their insertion in the manuals"

chain.label: AIRMET Zulu for icing omitted from flight release
chain.trigger: "AIRMET Zulu Update 3 for icing and freezing level was applicable to Flight 4184's route of flight ... but was not included in the Flight Release"

chain.label: Chicago TMC released flight from ground hold knowing airborne holding was likely
chain.trigger: "the Chicago Center Traffic Management Coordinator (TMC) improperly released Flight 4184 from a 42 minute ground hold ... despite having been informed ... that the flight would likely be required hold in the air"

chain.label: Aircraft held 33 minutes at 10,000 ft in cloud with liquid precipitation
chain.trigger: "the flight in the holding pattern lasted over 30 minutes in a cloudy atmosphere with liquid precipitation and at a SAT varying between -2 and -4°C"

caused_by.evidence: "Had Flight 4184 not been released prematurely, the flight would not have been required to hold at LUCIT intersection as long as it did"

chain.label: Prolonged freezing drizzle / large supercooled droplet environment beyond Appendix C
chain.trigger: "Aircraft S/N 401 has encountered established freezing drizzle / freezing rain conditions, the only one for such a duration of about 24 minutes"

caused_by.evidence: "Calculation of the time spent by the ATR 72 in precipitation leads to a cumulative time of almost 24 minutes"
"ROSELAWN conditions were far outside App 'C' certification envelope"

chain.label: Sterile cockpit not enforced; sustained non-pertinent conversation and loud music
chain.trigger: "broadcast music was playing in the cockpit for over 18 minutes"; "non-pertinent pilot and flight attendant conversation continues"

chain.label: Crew failed to recognize severity of icing; ignored caution chimes and ice observations
chain.trigger: "At 1533:56, a single tone which could have been the caution alert chime ... There is no discussion regarding the chime by the flight crew"; "we still got ice" was not acknowledged

caused_by.evidence: "These non-essential conversations directly contributed to the flight crews lack of vigilance in respect to monitoring and deviating from the known icing conditions"
"the crew was aware of the existence of light to moderate icing" only from partial information; the icing AIRMET was withheld

chain.label: Level II anti-icing and 86% propeller RPM not maintained in icing conditions
chain.trigger: "The propeller speed was reduced to 77% NP at 1525:00" although "the ATR-72 AFM requires ... the propeller speed be maintained at 86% NP whenever the aircraft is being operated in icing conditions"

caused_by.evidence: "Procedures relative to flights in icing conditions ... were not respected by the flightcrew"

chain.label: Crew held at flaps 15, close to VFE, a configuration not provided for in the manuals
chain.trigger: "The ATR-72 AFM does not provide for a Flap 15 configuration for holding"; "you want flaps fifteen?"

caused_by.evidence: "Complacency replaced vigilance and social discourse replaced proactive safety awareness and sound operational procedures"

chain.label: Crew did not request altitude change or report icing to ATC to exit conditions
chain.trigger: "There is no indication at this time, or at any other time during the flight, that the flight crew notified ATC that they had encountered and were operating in icing conditions"

caused_by.evidence: "which resulted in their failure to exit the known icing conditions prior to the ice-induced roll event"

chain.label: Boone controller did not solicit icing PIREP or report excessive holding delay
chain.trigger: "ATC controllers are required to solicit PIREPS ... icing of light degree or greater"; "neither the Central Flow Control Facility ... nor the Traffic Management Unit were advised that Flight 4184's holding time had exceeded 15 minutes"

caused_by.evidence: "Flight 4184's Expected Further Clearance (EFC) time was extended on four separate occasions"

chain.label: Ice ridge accreted on upper wing aft of the boots, upstream of the ailerons
chain.trigger: "the accretion of a ridge of ice aft of the de-icing boots, upstream of the ailerons"; "only a prolonged flight (17 mn) under large supercooled droplet conditions can produce a ridge downstream of the external boot active limit on the wing upper surface"

caused_by.evidence: "due to a prolonged operation of Flight 4184 in a freezing drizzle environment, well beyond the aircraft's certification envelope"
"collection at negative AOA (flaps 15°) which produce upper wing ice accretions potentially leading to aileron hinge moment reversal"
"which prevented them from exiting these conditions prior to the ice-induced roll event"
"Had the BOONE Sector Controller solicited a PIREP from Flight 4184 ... immediate precautionary action would have been taken by ATC to communicate with the crew regarding exiting the icing area"
"the crew ... left the propeller RPM at NP 77% while operating in icing conditions, as established by their late selection of NP 86%, only after ice had accreted"
"the ATR de-icing system was modified with extended overwing boots" only after the accident

chain.label: Flaps retracted at overspeed warning, raising angle of attack past the critical value
chain.trigger: "the CVR records the sound of repeating beeps similar to overspeed warning ... The flaps were then retracted to the flaps 0 position. During the flaps retraction, the AOA increased gradually from -1 degree to 6.5 degrees"

caused_by.evidence: "I'm sure that once they let us out of the hold and forget they're down, we'll get the overspeed"

chain.label: Ice-induced flow separation and aileron hinge moment reversal; aileron deflected to stop
chain.trigger: "At the critical value (4,8°) a flow separation initiated aft of the ridge ... triggered the hinge moment reversal and the subsequent aileron deflection up to its stop"

caused_by.evidence: "the roll upset was entirely due to the sudden deflection of the left aileron upwards to its stop ... caused by the profound alteration of the hinge moment"
"which led to a sudden roll upset following an unexpected Aileron Hinge Moment Reversal when the crew retracted the flaps during the descent"

chain.label: Autopilot self-disconnected as roll forces exceeded its authority
chain.trigger: "At 15.57:28.5, the autopilot disconnected. The left aileron then deflected abruptly downwards"

caused_by.evidence: "The autopilot disconnected due to its internal monitoring system"

chain.label: Crew surprised by the roll upset, having no training or warning for this specific event
chain.trigger: "their subsequent surprise and lack of appropriate control inputs to recover the aircraft when the event occurred"

caused_by.evidence: "The First Officer was flying the aircraft when the roll occurred. The Captain said 'oh' ... with the First Officer saying 'oops'"
"they were preoccupied with multiple distractions prior to the roll upset which affected their situational awareness to such an extent that they were precluded from effectively responding"

chain.label: Uncoordinated dual control inputs, no transfer of control, no crew communication
chain.trigger: "the First Officer and the Captain were pulling on the control column at different times without coordination. The CVR records no attempt to either transfer the controls to the Captain, or to coordinate flight control inputs"

caused_by.evidence: "the flight crew, probably disoriented, did not identify the unusual attitude nor understood the fast moving evolutions of the aircraft"

chain.label: Continued rolls through inverted, 73 degrees nose down, airspeed to 296 KIAS
chain.trigger: "The aircraft rolled rapidly to the right and continued to roll through an inverted position ... the pitch attitude reached a maximum of 73 degrees nose-down. The airspeed increased to 296 KIAS"

caused_by.evidence: "The Probable Cause of this accident is the loss of control of the aircraft by the flight crew, caused by the accretion of a ridge of ice aft of the de-icing boots"
"an aileron deflection of around 6° maintained in the direction opposite to the roll initiation would have been sufficient to stop the roll departure"

chain.label: Aircraft impacted terrain near Roselawn, Indiana
chain.trigger: "the crash of American Eagle flight 4184, an ATR 72 airplane during a rapid descent after an uncommanded roll excursion"

caused_by.evidence: "the integrity of the structure and the good operation of the systems was maintained until the last seconds before the impact"

chain.label: All 68 occupants fatally injured
chain.trigger: "There were 64 passengers, 2 flight attendants, and the 2 pilots on board the aircraft"; "the extensive fragmentation of the aircraft"

caused_by.evidence: "The analysis of the wreckage, made difficult by the extensive fragmentation of the aircraft"
